snippet.description:
Survive the Deranged Terror

Resident Evil Veronica is a remake of 2000's Resident Evil Code: Veronica.

This new title preserves the essence of the original game, while introducing modernized gameplay, a reimagined storyline, and vividly detailed graphics.

In 2027, madness and intrigue, love and hate all combine to create a chilling new entry in survival horror.

snippet.title: FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
As the world teeters on the brink of annihilation, the final battle against Sephiroth begins.
A meteor mars the sky, monstrous planetary guardians wreak havoc across the globe, and the fires of war rage. Now, Cloud and his companions must stand against this chaos to not only decide the planet's fate, but bring a legendary conflict to its conclusion.

In the final chapter of the FINAL FANTASY VII remake project, the scale has never been larger and the stakes have never been higher. Take to the skies and explore a boundless world, fight alongside a fully assembled party, master strategic and dynamic combat, and prepare yourself for the climactic finale.

A vast planet awaits. Everything leads here.

Release Date : Spring 2027
Platforms: PlayStation®5 / Nintendo Switch™ 2 / Xbox Series X|S / Windows / Steam / Epic Games Store

snippet.title: Star Wars Zero Company | Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Every Move Counts.  Command an elite squad through a gritty and authentic story in Star Wars Zero Company™, a single-player turn-based tactics game launching on PC, PlayStation®5, and Xbox Series X|S.  Coming August 27, 2026.

Each choice you make could alter the fate of the galaxy in this cinematic original story set in the twilight of the Clone Wars™ Era. 

Pre-order now to outfit your droids with the Crystalline Astromech Cosmetic Pack*: https://www.ea.com/games/starwars/zero-company/buy 

—————————————

Lead the Clone Wars’ Most Cunning Operatives - Command the galaxy’s finest in tactical operations, investigations and other heart-pounding missions through a cinematic original story set in the Clone Wars era. 

Choose Your Path to Victory - Strategize and adapt at both your base of operations and an ever-shifting battlefield to make every move count. The outcomes of your decisions make each playthrough different. 
 
Engage in Tactical Star Wars Combat - Deploy a team of operatives composed of a wide variety of character archetypes ranging from scoundrels to astromechs, or even a Jedi, choosing from an arsenal of tactical abilities to outmaneuver and defeat your foes. 

Forge Deep Bonds with your Squad - Improve your squad’s skills as you deploy them on missions, where they learn to work together and unlock new combat synergies that could be the difference between victory and defeat.

Personalize Your Fight - Customize your combat specialization and appearance for Hawks, then fill out your team with original and custom-made Star Wars characters, tailoring their appearances, loadouts, and abilities to fit your unique playstyle. 


#starwars #SWZeroCo

snippet.description:
Alyssa Grace - bloodstream (Lyrics)

https://found.ee/bloodstream-1

ALYSSA GRACE
https://www.instagram.com/alyssagracesings
https://www.tiktok.com/@alyssagraceofficial

Lyrics 🎤

Maybe I was too young to fully understand
So I never healed from a healthy, why I never trusted the man
You gotta love all that you have, and I'll take that to my grave
Soon you'll open up your eyes, and it'll all be gone one day
And I'm sitting here convincing you to pick up the phone and call
I am my father's daughter, but I'm nothing like him at all
And I hear him in the way I speak, or when I look in the mirror
The anger's growing in me, it shows, could it be any clearer?
That I'm like him 'cause he madе me the way I am
When wе're fighting, and all I need is somebody

And I'm crying on my mama's floor
Why don't you want this anymore?
And I'm craving you to change for me
You're saying, "I hear you, and I love you
But my heart, it hurts for you
And I just cannot give you what you need"
Am I too much? Am I enough?
'Cause you said you wouldn't give up
Now I'm numb on my knees
Praying to god, you'd talk to me
Wondering what it takes for you to stay off my mind
And far out of my bloodstream

You never laid your hands on me, and that's something I'm grateful for
But I should've known that you'd gone mad
When I saw the way you punched your doors
And I don't regret loving you cause I know that you needed it

snippet.description:

BUY NEW MERCH: https://kittensneeze-merch.store/

How are yall feelin after Ep 9?? Yall hanging in there?? I know I barely am, but what better way to send off a show as impactful and incredible as The Amazing Digital Circus than with a new song and music video? 

As always-- THIS IS A NON-CANON MUSIC VIDEO & SONG! IT IS IN NO WAY SHAPE OR FORM AFFILIATED WITH GLITCH!

I want to thank Amanda and Lizzie for singing on this track, we actually recorded it probablyyyy 5 or so months ago, but we spent a lot of time on the video behind the scenes for you guys! They did an incredible job and I am always so honored to work with them to bring my creations to life. Please go give them tons of love and support and watch the movie in theaters if you can!

This will probably be my last big TADC song (we shall see what the future holds) and I'm really thankful for the amazing team who helped make it happen. 

It is always the biggest honor working with the talent that I work with and I want to continue to uplift them in any and every way! Thank you to this community and for all of you guys for supporting what we do. We couldn't make it happen without y'all.

snippet.title: Mighty Cuphead Adventure | Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Now in development at Studio MDHR, it’s… Mighty Cuphead Adventure! That’s right: this is a brand-new, riveting Cuphead video game that will bring the most advanced 8-bit action platforming to life on your television set in 32 dazzling colors.

Programmed in Assembly Language, Mighty Cuphead Adventure is designed with the precise, authentic specifications of the Sega Master System home gaming console.  While the game will still be compatible with modern consoles and personal computers, those who want a true blast from the past can experience it on a physical cartridge for the Sega Master System home gaming console. They just don’t make ’em like they used to…until we decided to!

To find out more, visit https://www.mightycuphead.com today!

Each player is also given their own piece of undeveloped real estate along with a virtual toolbox with which to design and build anything — be it a navigable skyscraper, a working helicopter, a giant pinball machine, a multiplayer “Capture the Flag” game or some other, yet-to-be-dreamed-up creation. snippet.title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced: Official Summer Game Fest Trailer
snippet.description:
Available July 9, 2026 on PlayStation®5, Xbox Series X|S and PC: https://ubi.li/O5sQ5

Featuring “Leave her Johnny” Resynced by Woodkid, a reimagined version of the iconic sea shanty.
Stream here: https://ubisoftmusic.ffm.to/acbfresyncedwoodkid

Piracy is a dangerous path. Adventure calls, bonds are tested, and the relentless pursuit of freedom and a better life comes at a perilous cost. In Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced, play as Edward Kenway as he carves his legend during the Golden Age of Piracy.

Learn more: https://assassinscreedblackflagresynced.com

About Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced:
Rebuilt from the ground up and powered by the latest Anvil engine, the iconic solo pirate adventure returns.  Sail the Caribbean as Edward Kenway during the Golden Age of Piracy in this faithfully enhanced remake featuring stunning visuals, upgraded gameplay, and new content. As you follow Edward in his pursuit of glory and gold, you’ll be drawn into an ancient war separating Assassins and Templars, with the fate of everything the pirates have built hanging in the balance.

Raise the Black Flag and let your reign over the seas begin.

Lyrics:

I'm going under, and this time, I fear there's no one to save me
This all or nothing really got a way of driving me crazy
I need somebody to hear, somebody to know
Somebody to have, somebody to hold
It's easy to say, but it's never the same
I guess I kinda liked the way you numbed all the pain

[Chorus]
Now, the day bleeds into nightfall
And you're not here to get me through it all
I let my guard down and then you pulled the rug
I was getting kinda used to being someone you loved

I'm going under, and this time, I fear there's no one to turn to
This all or nothing way of loving got me sleeping without you
Now, I need somebody to know, somebody to hear
Somebody to have, just to know how it feels
It's easy to say, but it's never the same
I guess I kinda like the way you help me escape

[Chorus]

And you're not here to get me through it all
I let my guard down and then you pulled the rug
I was getting kinda used to being someone you loved

[Bridge]

I fall into your arms
I'll be safe in your sound till I come back around

[Chorus]

snippet.title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer™ | Official Story Trailer
snippet.description:
Darius Pax may have founded the Galactic League, but Kestar Bool dominates it. As talented as he is villainous, Kestar uses his position as League Champion to threaten other pilots and extend his powerful reach even further. In a bid to retain control over his racing league, Darius Pax enlists the help of Shade, a mysterious pilot with a personal grudge against the Bool family. With the help of energetic engineer Hibi and a certain legendary podracer, Shade's sights are set on unseating the corrupt reigning champion.

Embark on a Star Wars™ adventure unlike any other and experience a rivalry that will define the course of the Galactic League in Star Wars: Galactic Racer™.

Launching worldwide on October 6th. Pre-order today for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC.

snippet.title: Finding Frankie 2 - Official Game Trailer
snippet.description:
#findingfrankie #horrorgaming 

Wishlist the game on Steam Now: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4606560/Finding_Frankie_2/

Finding Frankie 2 is an upcoming single-player parkour horror game that throws you into the final season of Frankie’s deadly televised game show.

100 contestants enter the world’s most dangerous parkour obstacle course for a chance to win the $10 million grand prize. Wall run, rail grind, vault, slide, trampoline jump, and survive your way through twisted traps, brutal eliminations, terrifying monsters, and some of the most intense parkour ever seen in a horror game!!

Finding Frankie 2 has no shortage of jumpscares, scares, scary moments, and horrifying mascot monsters, but it also pushes parkour horror further than ever before!! Explore through Frankie’s biggest and deadliest obstacle complex yet, packed with massive trampoline parks, impossible parkour challenges, game show trials, and high-speed chase sequences that will TERRIFY you!

Taking inspiration from horror games like Five Nights at Freddy’s/FNaF, Poppy Playtime, Bendy and the Ink Machine, Choo-Choo Charles, and other iconic indie horror titles, Finding Frankie 2 hopes to continue a new wave of parkour-themed horror experiences.

Will you survive Frankie’s final season and win the $10 million prize, or will you become just another elimination?

Wishlist Finding Frankie 2 on Steam!
#FindingFrankie #FindingFrankieGame #FindingFrankieTrailer

snippet.title: The Wolf Among Us:Remastered Reveal Trailer (Telltale Games)
snippet.description:
The Wolf Among Us:Remastered Reveal Trailer (Telltale Games)

Check out the Reveal Trailer for The Wolf Among Us Remastered, an updated remaster of the hit original narrative-driven decision-based game developed by Telltale Games. Experience the story of Bigby across five chapters in The Wolf Among Us Remastered, launching in Holiday 2026 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store) Step back into Fabletown in The Wolf Among Us Remastered - the definitive edition of Telltale’s acclaimed noir narrative thriller inspired by DC’s award-winning Fables comic series. Winner of multiple Game of the Year awards and still regarded as one of Telltale’s most acclaimed narrative adventures, The Wolf Among Us returns in this dark neon-noir thriller inspired by DC’s award-winning Fables comic series. In Fabletown, characters from myth and legend live secretly among us. As Sheriff Bigby Wolf, you investigate a brutal murder that uncovers a conspiracy threatening the fragile balance between Fabletown and the modern world. Rebuilt with enhanced visuals and modern presentation, this is the version longtime fans have been waiting for and the perfect entry point for a new generation stepping into Fabletown for the first time. Every decision carries consequences. Justice in Fabletown isn’t clean, and sometimes the Big Bad Wolf is the only one willing to do what must be done.

snippet.title: Can You Beat DARK SOULS 1 Without Aggroing Enemies?
snippet.description:
Looking to upgrade your PC, but struggling to build one yourself? Apex Gaming PCs has you covered.
Use my code "BACKLOGS" to get a 3% discount : https://apexgamingpcs.co/TheBacklogs

Were you able to beat my run? Prove it : https://discord.gg/5heQDyRnfr

Stealth mechanics. Hastily introduced into almost every RPG game since the Thief games hit the market, even Dark Souls has some semblance of stealth mechanics. But most players don't even know they're there.

So today, we're going to see how far into the game we can get without alerting/aggroing any enemies, in a game that doesn't have a dedicated stealth mechanic.

This should go well.

snippet.title: I Survived 200 Days in DUNGEONS & DRAGONS in Minecraft Hardcore!
snippet.description:
I Survived 200 Days in DUNGEONS & DRAGONS in Minecraft Hardcore!

Otherworld is a Minecraft modpack that turns the game into a Fantasy RPG game, inspired by the Dungeons & Dragons tabletop rpg. There's character selection with races and classes, a full leveling system with stats and skills, and tons of custom content as well as dozens of bosses and different structures. And to tie everything together, there's a massive quest tree with 6 complete chapters that we'll have to progress through. In this video it's my goal to survive 200 days, while gearing my character up, and hopefully defeating the final boss in the process. Enjoy!

Modpack: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/otherworld-dnd

snippet.title: NEW DMZ Gameplay Details: Crafting, Forward Operating Base, Bounty System, Dynamic Weather & MORE!
snippet.description:
Today I'm releasing new DMZ gameplay details early! DMZ is coming to Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 as a third game mode and it's being massively expanded and improved on the DMZ Beta from 2022. This includes a new map called Hajin featuring dynamic weather effects and more robust AI enemies including Hostile Elites, Dangerous Lieutenants and Roaming Commanders. DMZ is bringing new progression elements such as a Trait Tree to add to Active Duty Slots as well as a brand-new Bounty System designed to bring more tension and chaos to the PvP elements of the game. Lastly, an out-of-match Forward Operating Base is being added to allow you to craft equipment and rare items with your 3D Printer for future raids. Don't forget to drop a LIKE and hit the SUBSCRIBE button to catch my latest videos. Thanks for watching!
